description: Review a SQL migration for destructive and blocking operations — dropped tables and columns, NOT NULL columns without defaults, type changes and renames — and deliver a safe deployment order. Before running a migration against a database that is serving traffic. Do not choose this when you need an execution plan or an actual lock-time estimate. Example requests: Is this migration safe to run on a live database? | Review this SQL migration for downtime risks. | What could go wrong if I run this migration?
